rule dac_gh_0010 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Fine-grained PAT created for privileged org resources - fine_grained_personal_access_token.create"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0010"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1528"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "fine_grained_personal_access_token.create" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "personal_access_token.access_granted" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
